name: Ame wa Subete o Nagasanai
source:
A cheerful, spirit-lifting second-year high school student named Yuma Shimotsuki falls instantly in love with the gloomy beauty Mio Amabara.

During the melancholy rainy season, a cruel fate befalls the two as they yearn for happiness.

Theirs was a bond forged in suffering.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13454]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
性格开朗、精神振奋的高中二年级生下月由真立刻爱上了阴郁的美女天原澪。

忧郁的雨季，向往幸福的二人却遭遇残酷的命运。

他们的纽带是在苦难中结成的。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13454]Novelgame[/url]]
